bonuses.name: Adaptive Strategy
bonuses.text: At the start of each Round, one Mob or individual with the same <DYNASTY> Keyword as this Threat within 10 m can Seize the Initiative for free.

bonuses.name: Champion
bonuses.text: This Threat may use Ruin Actions and has 1 personal Ruin.

bonuses.name: Living Metal
bonuses.text: At the start of each of this Threat’s turns it regains 1 Wound and 1 Shock.

bonuses.name: Relentless March
bonuses.text: Every Mob or individual with the same [DYNASTY] Keyword as this Threat within 10 m gains +1 Speed.

abilities.name: Reanimation Protocols
abilities.text: When this Threat is destroyed, roll a d6. If the result is an Exalted Icon, it is resurrected with 1 Wound and 1 Shock.
